$comment: One coherent, pinned dependency baseline for the Antifragile Floor v4 hook. Recorded per the Programmable v4 builder upstream-sources policy (stable OpenZeppelin uniswap-hooks profile). Do not float or mix generations; changing any pin requires re-testing the whole set in isolation.

solidity.note: cancun required by Uniswap v4 (EIP-1153 transient storage). Compiles at optimizer_runs=200 without via_ir (matches upstream v4-core/periphery debug profile).

@openzeppelin/uniswap-hooks.role: Provides BaseHook (src/base/BaseHook.sol) and the coherent dependency family declaration.
@openzeppelin/uniswap-hooks.note: Pin by exact npm version + integrity + this source commit. Do NOT pin the similarly named git tag v1.1.1 (bd5287c...), whose package metadata says 1.2.1 and ships the preview src tree.

@openzeppelin/contracts.role: Solidity utilities used by uniswap-hooks (IERC20, SafeERC20, SlotDerivation, TransientSlot, SafeCast) and by v4-core (proxy/Proxy.sol).
@openzeppelin/contracts.note: Coherent family resolution required by the stable profile. uniswap-hooks 1.1.1 declares '^5.5.0'; npm floated it to 5.6.1, so it was pinned back down to exactly 5.5.0 as a direct save-exact dependency (5.5.0 satisfies ^5.5.0 -> no conflict). 5.5.0 provides TransientSlot/SlotDerivation which the bundled v4-core copy (5.0.2) lacks. sourceCommit not provided by the baseline; pinned by npm integrity.

@uniswap/v4-core.role: PoolManager, Hooks permission library, PoolKey/PoolId/BalanceDelta/BeforeSwapDelta types, and test/utils/Deployers.sol harness. Also bundles the coherent lib/forge-std (1.9.3) and lib/solmate used by tests.
@uniswap/v4-core.note: Coherent family resolution required by the stable profile. sourceCommit not provided by the baseline; pinned by npm integrity.

@uniswap/v4-periphery.role: Provides HookMiner (src/utils/HookMiner.sol) used to mine the permission-matched CREATE2 hook address in tests.
@uniswap/v4-periphery.note: Coherent family resolution required by the stable profile. NOTE: upstream v4-periphery HEAD has since removed BaseHook + HookMiner (they moved to Uniswap/v4-hooks-public), but this pinned 1.0.3 npm artifact still ships HookMiner in src/utils/, so no extra install was needed. sourceCommit not provided by the baseline; pinned by npm integrity.

forgeStd.provenance: Bundled inside @uniswap/v4-core@1.0.2 at node_modules/@uniswap/v4-core/lib/forge-std (covered by that package's npm integrity above).
forgeStd.note: Chosen over a separate `forge install` so that v4-core's Deployers.sol and this project's tests resolve the SAME, coherent forge-std that v4-core 1.0.2 was built against. This forge-std (1.9.x) vendors its assertions and needs no ds-test. sourceCommit not resolved to a git hash; the exact bytes are pinned via the v4-core npm integrity.

baseHook.source: OpenZeppelin uniswap-hooks 1.1.1 (its own BaseHook, NOT the stale v4-periphery BaseHook).
baseHook.constructor: constructor(IPoolManager _poolManager) — calls validateHookAddress(this), so deployment requires a permission-matched CREATE2 address.

hookMiner.source: Uniswap v4-periphery 1.0.3 (still bundles HookMiner in this pinned version; not sourced from v4-hooks-public).
